# 99 Purity Wholesale - Comprehensive LLM Context & Developer Documentation

## 1. Project Overview & Business Logic
99 Purity Wholesale is a high-end, premium B2B e-commerce platform designed exclusively for laboratory and research procurement. It specializes in high-purity research peptides, amino acids, and chemical compounds. 

**Core Differentiator:** 
The platform operates on an "Inquiry/Quote" model rather than direct B2C checkout. Users browse products (sold in bulk Kits, e.g., "10mg × 10 Vials"), add them to an Inquiry Cart, and submit a Request for Quote (RFQ) to the sales team.

## 2. Technology Stack & Frameworks
- **Core Framework:** Next.js 14 (App Router methodology)
- **Language:** TypeScript (Strict typing for components and data models)
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS (utility-first), utilizing custom theme variables for luxury aesthetics (glassmorphism, gradients).
- **Animations:** Framer Motion (page transitions, micro-interactions) & GSAP/Lenis (Smooth Scrolling).
- **Internationalization (i18n):** `next-intl` handling middleware routing for English (`en`) and Spanish (`es`).
- **Icons:** `lucide-react`
- **PWA (Progressive Web App):** Configured via `next-pwa` for offline capabilities and mobile installability.

## 3. Architecture & Directory Structure
```text
/
├── public/                 # Static public assets
│   ├── product-images/     # High-res .webp images (89 active products)
│   └── sw.js               # Service Worker for PWA
├── messages/                # JSON dictionary files for translations (en.json, es.json)
├── src/
│   ├── app/                # Next.js App Router root
│   │   ├── [locale]/       # Dynamic locale segment for i18n
│   │   ├── api/            # Serverless API Routes (e.g., /api/og for dynamic images)
│   │   ├── sitemap.ts      # Dynamic XML sitemap generator
│   │   └── robots.ts       # Robots.txt generator
│   ├── components/         # Reusable React components (Client & Server)
│   │   ├── products/       # Product grids, cards, AddToInquiry buttons
│   │   ├── cart/           # Shopping/Inquiry Cart drawer and logic
│   │   ├── search/         # Command-palette style global search
│   │   ├── seo/            # Shared JSON-LD schema components (BreadcrumbSchema, FaqSchema, ArticleSchema)
│   │   ├── layout/         # Site Header, Footer, and Navigation
│   │   └── ui/              # Micro-components (buttons, inputs)
│   ├── data/               # Static JSON/TS Databases (Source of Truth)
│   │   ├── products.json   # 89 compounds, specs, and categories
│   │   ├── locations.json  # 50 US States + major cities for Local SEO
│   │   └── services-content/ # Per-service content modules (dropshipping, private-label, etc.) + index.ts registry
│   ├── hooks/              # Custom React Hooks
│   │   ├── useNestedSmoothScroll.ts # Lenis scroll integration
│   │   └── useCart.ts      # Context hook for inquiry state
│   ├── i18n/               # next-intl configuration and routing
│   └── lib/                # Utility functions and search engines (Fuzzy search)
```

## 4. Data Models & State Management
### Product Schema (`src/data/products.json`)
The source of truth for the catalog.
- `name` (string): e.g., "BPC-157 / TB-500 Blend"
- `slug` (string): URL identifier (e.g., `bpc-157-tb-500-blend`)
- `category` (string): e.g., `recovery-research`
- `specs` (string[]): Pack sizes available (e.g., `["5mg×10", "10mg×10"]`)
- `description` (string): SEO-optimized scientific description.

### Cart State (`CartProvider`)
State is managed globally via React Context. The cart tracks `items` (which include `productId`, `spec`, and `quantity`) and syncs with `localStorage` to persist inquiries across sessions.

## 5. UI/UX Design System
- **Typography:** Custom fonts are heavily utilized:
  - `font-absans`: Used for bold, modern headlines.
  - `font-archia`: Used for technical copy and body text.
  - `font-dm-mono`: Used for technical specs, badges, and small caps.
  - `font-dm-sans`: Used for general UI text.
- **Aesthetics:** The site uses a "scientific luxury" theme featuring:
  - Blurry backdrops (`backdrop-blur-xl`)
  - Subtle noise overlays (`bg-[url('.../noise.svg')]`) for texture.
  - Minimalist monochromatic palettes with sharp accent colors.

## 6. Advanced Implementations
- **Image Mapping Engine:** Because product images are static, they are mapped explicitly in `src/components/products/ProductDirectory.tsx` (for the grid) and `src/app/[locale]/products/[slug]/page.tsx` (for individual pages mapped by spec).
- **Fuzzy Search:** Built into `src/lib/search.ts` to allow users to quickly search for complex chemical names with typo tolerance.
- **Peptide Calculator:** A complex client-side tool allowing researchers to input vial capacity and bacteriostatic water volume to calculate exact dosage per syringe tick mark.

## 7. SEO & Indexing Strategy
- **Flattened URLs:** Products are accessed via `/products/[slug]` (removing the category sub-path) to maximize URL authority.
- **Dynamic Sitemap:** `sitemap.ts` programmatically loops through `products.json`, `locations.json`, `services-content`, and MDX blog posts to generate 1,000+ valid URLs across both locales, each with reciprocal `hreflang` (`alternates.languages`) entries linking the en/es versions.
- **Hreflang:** Every page's `generateMetadata` sets `alternates.languages` (en-US / es / x-default) in addition to `canonical`.
- **Structured Data:** JSON-LD is emitted per page type — `Organization` (site-wide), `Product`, `Service`, `LocalBusiness`, `FAQPage`, `Article`, `BreadcrumbList`, `DefinedTermSet` (glossary), `WebApplication` (peptide calculator). Ratings/review counts are intentionally omitted from `Product`/`Organization` schema since there is no real review system — fabricated `aggregateRating` values are a Google structured-data policy violation.
- **Open Graph (OG) Images:** Dynamic OG images are generated using Next.js Image Response (`/api/og`) to create shareable link previews.
- **Robots.txt:** `src/app/robots.ts` explicitly blocks `/api/`, `/_next/`, and `/static/`, and explicitly allow-lists AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, anthropic-ai).

## 8. Deployment & Build Notes
- Runs on Vercel (or standard Node.js server using `npm run start`).
- Requires `npm run build` to pre-render the massive static footprint (SSG) of location pages and product research pages.
- Edge runtime is selectively used/disabled depending on static generation requirements.

## 9. Target Market & Demand Generation
- **Target Audience:** The primary demographics are compounding pharmacies, independent research laboratories, universities, and bio-tech startups. 
- **Wholesale Demand Drivers:** The site targets high-volume B2B buyers looking for rigorously tested (HPLC & Mass Spectrometry) compounds with verifiable Certificates of Analysis (COAs). 
- **SEO Keyword Focus:** The architecture (flattened URLs and location pages) is specifically designed to capture localized B2B search demand (e.g., "wholesale research peptides in [State/City]").
- **Value Proposition:** 99%+ purity guaranteed, batch-matched testing, and secure US-based priority logistics.
